description: This file defines a culture information object for the 'sma-NO' (Southern Sami - Norway) locale in the DateJS library. It includes locale-specific names for days and months, formatting patterns, regex patterns for parsing dates, and various date manipulation functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this date equals another date.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if the date is after another date.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if the date is before another date.

methods.name: isToday
methods.description: Checks if the date is today.
